home.title:
Chess has
a third side.
home.description: Three armies enter from different edges of a hexagonal board. The last king in play wins.
home.ruleBody: Play on 91 hexagonal cells. Each army starts on a different edge. White moves first, then Black, then Red.

game.boardNote: Pawns advance away from their home edge.
game.selectPiece: Choose a piece, then a highlighted square.
game.confirmReset: Start a new game? The current position will be replaced.

rules.board: The board has six sides and 91 hexagonal cells. Players start on alternating edges.
rules.turns: White moves, then Black, then Red. Each army’s pawns advance in its own direction.
rules.pieces: Rooks follow edges and bishops follow corners. Knights jump two steps in one direction and one step along a neighboring direction. Kings can take one rook or bishop step. Pawns advance one cell, capture to either forward flank, and promote on the far boundary.
rules.elimination: Checkmate takes a player out. Their pieces become still blockers. The last king wins.
